auth_details: API key in the endpoint path, or Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY with the key omitted from the path.
paid_plans: Growth Plan usage pricing; currently advertised at $2 per additional 100,000 queries, payable by card or GRT.
resolution_notes: auth.details: auditor correct. Official Querying Subgraphs docs (https://thegraph.com/docs/en/subgraphs/querying/from-an-application/) document two methods only: (1) API key in path as /api/[api-key]/subgraphs/id/[subgraph-id], or (2) Authorization: Bearer header with /api/subgraphs/id/[subgraph-id]. No ordinary query-parameter form is documented. pricing: auditor correct. Billing page (https://thegraph.com/docs/en/subgraphs/billing/) and plan comparison (https://thegraph.com/studio/apikeys/) show Free Plan includes 100,000 queries/month; Growth Plan is usage-based at $2 per additional 100,000 queries, payable by card or GRT. Original free_tier_limits/paid_plans "unknown" was wrong.
